rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now it is your king that is in check: the black rook on e8 attacks e1.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: There are three ways out: run with the king, block the line of attack or capture the checking piece.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: The first is to run: the king goes to a square the rook does not reach.
rot.ideia.ex1.e4: The rook reaches the whole file of the letter e. So the king must leave it.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Run from the check with the king, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Off the e-file, the king is safe.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The king steps sideways, off the e-file.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Run from the check with the king, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Any of the four squares would do: d1, d2, f1 and f2.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember the idea: running means taking the king to a square no enemy piece reaches.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The black rook gives check along the first rank, and the king has nowhere to run.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The second way out is to block: put one of your pieces between the rook and the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Block the check with the bishop, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The bishop blocks the way, and the check is over.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The bishop goes back to f1 and stands between the rook and the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Block the check with the bishop, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The bishop on f1 is protected by the king: if the rook captures it, the king captures the rook.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Remember the idea: blocking means putting a piece on the line between the attacker and the king.
rot.ideia.ex3.e1: Again the black rook gives check along the first rank. Now you have a rook on a1.
rot.ideia.ex3.e2: The third way out is to capture the checking piece.
rot.ideia.ex3.p: Capture the checking piece, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex3.certo: That's right! The black rook left the board, and the check with it.
rot.ideia.ex3.revela: Your rook captures the black rook on e1.
rot.ideia.ex3.volta: Capture the checking piece, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex3.l1: Capturing is often the best way out: the check ends and you also win the piece.
rot.ideia.ex3.l2: Remember the three ways out: run, block and capture.
rot.ideia.ex3.l3: Now I will show when one of them does not work.
rot.demos.cavalo.e1: The black knight on d3 gives check to the king on e1.
rot.demos.cavalo.e2: A knight's check cannot be blocked: he jumps over any piece.
rot.demos.cavalo.l1: So you can only run or capture. Here the pawn captures the knight, diagonally.
rot.demos.protegida.e1: The black rook on e2 gives check, right next to the king.
rot.demos.protegida.e2: The king captures too, but only a loose piece: capturing a protected piece would put him in check.
rot.demos.protegida.e3: Here the pawn on d3 protects the rook. The king cannot capture it.
rot.demos.protegida.l1: So the king runs to f1, out of reach of the rook and the pawn.
rot.demos.protegida.l2: Remember: the king only captures a loose piece.
rot.demos.semSaida.e1: The same rook on the first rank, but now without the bishop or the white rook.
rot.demos.semSaida.l1: Running is impossible: the pawns on f2, g2 and h2 fill the squares above, and f1 and h1 are on the rook's rank.
rot.demos.semSaida.l2: Blocking and capturing don't work either: no white piece gets to f1 or e1. It is checkmate.
rot.demos.semSaida.l3: Now it's your turn. The best way out is to capture the checking piece, when it is loose.
rot.pratica.reiCaptura.enunciado: The black rook gives check, right next to the king. Choose the best way out, in one move.
rot.pratica.reiCaptura.fim: Perfect. Nobody protected the rook, so the king captured it himself.
rot.pratica.reiCaptura.err.e1d1: Running works, but the rook was loose: the king could capture it. Try again.
rot.pratica.reiCaptura.err.e1f1: Running works, but the rook was loose: the king could capture it. Try again.
rot.pratica.melhorSaida.enunciado: Check on the first rank. There are two ways out; choose the best, in one move.
rot.pratica.melhorSaida.fim: Well done. Run, block or capture: now you know how to get out of check and choose the best way.
rot.pratica.melhorSaida.err.d3f1: Blocking works, but you could capture the rook and win 5. Try again.
